_comment: Role -> fallback chain. Chains are CROSS-PROVIDER by design.
The failure actually observed here is a KEY-level 429 that takes out every model on
that key at once, so a chain that stays inside one provider does not survive it.
Each chain therefore spans nvidia -> kilo -> zai wherever possible.
Every entry confirmed live 2026-09-13. Of the 82 models NVIDIA lists, only 11 answer;
/v1/models is a catalogue, not an entitlement. Probe before adding anything here.
json_mode is OFF everywhere: nemotron returns {"":""} with it, mistral-nemotron
times out with it. Ask for JSON in the prompt and parse leniently instead.
_concurrency_note: 3, not 8. The key rate-limits at ~4+ sustained: a juror scored 38/200 at limit=8 and 190/200 at limit=3 with backoff.

guard.purpose: promo/chatter detection on every message — cheapest that is reliable

router.purpose: intent classification on every message — the hot path

analyst.purpose: deep extraction on the ~10% that matter (IPO fields, materiality)
analyst._max_tokens_note: 3000, not 1200. nemotron-3-super is a REASONING model: at 1200 it spent the budget thinking and was cut mid-JSON on 4 of 12 hand-verified IPO posts (P7). The failure is silent from the caller's side — the call returns ok=True with a truncated body — so the budget has to be right rather than merely large enough on average.

vision._note: gemma-4-31b-it read a synthetic IPO card with every field correct in 98s; llama-3.2-11b misread GMP 45 as 46, so it is fallback only and its numbers must be verified. Images MUST be downscaled to 1280px first — full-size screenshots time out.

writer.purpose: compose the email — judged on plain-English clarity in P8

known_dead._comment: Probed and confirmed non-functional on this key. Do not re-add without re-probing.
http_503_capacity: poolside/laguna-xs-2.1 (nvidia) — scored 93.3% during the benchmark, then went 503 ResourceExhausted on every retry. REMOVED from all chains: a model whose capacity vanishes mid-day is not a fallback.

_provider_note.nvidia: primary. 11 of 82 listed models work. Key-level 429 on sustained load.
_provider_note.kilo: OpenRouter gateway, 377 models, 20 free. Needs HTTP-Referer + X-Title headers.
_provider_note.zai: last resort only — glm-4.5-flash works but measured 11s and 42s. glm-4.5-air/4.6 return 429 insufficient-balance.
